race.title: John Durkan Memorial Punchestown Chase (Grade 1)
race.verdict: Willie Mullins has dominated this race in recent times and GAELIC WARRIOR is taken to land the prize for the second year in succession. After impressive wins at both Cheltenham and this course in the spring, he can pick up where he left off to confirm the placings with Fact To File from last year's renewal, with Final Demand completing the shortlist. GAELIC WARRIOR (GER) FACT TO FILE (FR) FINAL DEMAND (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Gaelic Warrior (10/11), Fact To File (9/4), Kitzbuhel (8/1), Final Demand (12/1), Impaire Et Passe (14/1), Kaid D'authie (16/1), The Big Westerner (20/1), Grangeclare West (50/1), I Am Maximus (50/1), Nick Rockett (50/1)
